roadmap_inputs.symptom: Static status-driven audit and design loops repeat without a new material risk.
roadmap_inputs.gap: No machine-readable review_requirements carrier binds trigger, scope, evidence freshness, reuse and required check.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: A material-triggered review requirement is deterministic and reusable while its inputs are unchanged; historical/process deviations alone do not request another audit, while authority and frozen-contract gates remain fail-closed.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: A bounded reversible defect is terminalized as Blocked or plan-design escalation.
roadmap_inputs.gap: Nonterminal event/state semantics exist, but there is no closed all-five repair evidence carrier or Files-boundary enforcement for an incidental repair.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: A qualified repair records one path, all classifier predicates, pre/post original validation and bounded diff; semantic, multi-path, generated, authority and contract changes fail closed.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: Caller-supplied model or effort can create a false routing verdict.
roadmap_inputs.gap: cli-flag proves fresh launch selection only; Codex supplies no immutable thread-bound effective model+effort telemetry.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: Provider-bound route evidence controls admission; absent evidence returns a typed nonterminal unverifiable result and never fabricates blocked state or actual-route telemetry.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: A self-invalidating single evidence anchor produces repeated symptom-level RED audits.
roadmap_inputs.gap: Stable phase fingerprints exist, but explicit spec/product/closure anchors, collision refusal and product byte-identity are absent.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: Self-invalidating input/output collisions refuse before mutation; split anchors close with byte-identical product paths and grouped same-seam audit repair.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: The agent can emit transport-level final while the item remains nonterminal.
roadmap_inputs.gap: Task receipts are byte-bound, but provider final enforcement, quiet/heartbeat policy and interrupted-resume lifecycle are outside the implemented seam.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: Actual provider final is rejected without a fresh terminal receipt; long work has bounded liveness and resumes the same authorized run without a new owner approval.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: A terminal response can omit or alter the exact persisted next-step recommendation.
roadmap_inputs.gap: Receipt verification covers persisted bytes, but no runtime/harness hook verifies the emitted final transcript before run completion.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: Green, deviation, blocked, phase and archive transcript fixtures must contain the exact receipt recommendation; missing or mismatched Next prevents completion.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: Generated callers prescribe history --stdout while the CLI rejects that flag.
roadmap_inputs.gap: History stdout is implicit, but --stdout is still advertised globally and explicitly rejected for history; callers are not regenerated around one interface.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: One canonical history command emitted by state/help executes successfully, and the deprecated contradictory form is removed or supported consistently with regression coverage.

roadmap_inputs.symptom: A declared multi-item batch can be split into standalone item invocations before Task consults the roadmap.
roadmap_inputs.gap: No execution-batches schema, pre-mutation resolver, ROADMAP_BATCH_REQUIRED refusal, checkpoint or batch receipt exists.
roadmap_inputs.acceptance: A partial direct invocation is refused before journal start with the exact canonical batch command; exact batch and durable resume subsets preserve ordered item commits and continuation.

owner_requirements.requirement: Do not stop or leave work incomplete without a reproducible reason.
owner_requirements.current_seam: Continue-first command prose plus nonterminal journal/state observations.
owner_requirements.gap: The policy is not yet closed across route, repair, block and delivery transport seams.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Every signal follows reproduce/classify/action/verify and only a proven safety, authority or acceptance boundary terminalizes work.

owner_requirements.requirement: Bounded local deviations repair inline instead of opening Blocked, escalation or another design pass.
owner_requirements.current_seam: journal local-repair observation and plan_blocking local branch.
owner_requirements.gap: All-five repair evidence and Files-boundary enforcement are missing.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Qualified bounded repair repeats the original carrier in the same attempt; material changes fail closed.

owner_requirements.requirement: Every external blocker is verified by RAG rather than model memory.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan_blocking requires verified nonempty RAG evidence for external candidates.
owner_requirements.gap: Schema does not attest the specifically required Perplexity tool or preserve rag-pending after bounded failure.
owner_requirements.acceptance: External terminal verdict coverage is complete; required Perplexity failure remains nonterminal rag-pending and fallback evidence cannot close the gate.

owner_requirements.requirement: Terminal Blocked is confirmed by one independent agent; otherwise root continues.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan_blocking requires isolated-child-return, reviewer_actor != executor_actor and JUSTIFIED.
owner_requirements.gap: Candidate implementation still requires phase acceptance and provider projection parity verification.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Only one fresh independent JUSTIFIED verdict plus deterministic boundary allows terminal block; all other verdicts return to repair or evidence.

owner_requirements.requirement: New plans use YYYY.MM.DD-№N-CODE and Title starts with План №N.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan_lint_checks.common numbered regexes and parsing numbered identity checks.
owner_requirements.gap: Candidate is implemented but not yet accepted as the frozen package contract.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Positive same-day ordinal and matching Title are enforced for new plans while legacy identifiers remain readable.

owner_requirements.requirement: Comments and docstrings reference the full PLAN-ID plus item, never ambiguous bare Pn.m.
owner_requirements.current_seam: Plan-protocol prose declares the qualified form.
owner_requirements.gap: Current lint does not inspect arbitrary product comments/docstrings or provider projections for bare item references.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Canonical and both provider projections detect ambiguous bare item references and accept qualified PLAN-ID Pn.m references.

owner_requirements.requirement: Complete plan, implementation, release tag and rollout in one authorized lifecycle.
owner_requirements.current_seam: Active phase-first plan with P6 release and registered-project rollout boundary.
owner_requirements.gap: P0-P5 acceptance must complete before release/tag/rollout; no early side effects are authorized.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Affected package gates pass, local v0.13.0 is created only after terminal P6.1, and rollout touches only registered channels with post-status evidence.

owner_requirements.requirement: Keep the plan active through release and rollout.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plans/ACTIVE.md and active Layout-v2 plan directory.
owner_requirements.gap: None at P0.1; the invariant must remain true until terminal archive.
owner_requirements.acceptance: The plan remains active and visible until release and rollout are terminal.

owner_requirements.requirement: Use explicit Layout v2 with separate detailed phase and item carriers.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan Layout v2 plus phases/Pn/Pn.md, Pn.m.md, bundles and generated state.
owner_requirements.gap: None for this plan; later v1 fleet migration remains separate P1 work.
owner_requirements.acceptance: All active execution carriers are v2 and pass bundle/state/status checks.

owner_requirements.requirement: Treat existing implementation as a candidate and re-accept it phase by phase.
owner_requirements.current_seam: Phase-first execution rules and item-scoped validation.
owner_requirements.gap: Candidate seams remain partial/open as recorded by R1-R8.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Each phase closes only after its declared targeted checks and terminal gate, without inheriting a previous candidate verdict.

owner_requirements.requirement: Do not tag or roll out before the visible active plan closes its pre-release gates.
owner_requirements.current_seam: P6 phase boundary; no current v0.13.0 side effect.
owner_requirements.gap: Release and rollout are intentionally pending.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Tag creation follows terminal P6.1 and rollout follows the tag gate.

owner_requirements.requirement: Required Perplexity evidence cannot be replaced by empty, unavailable or fallback search results.
owner_requirements.current_seam: Plan evidence records a repaired live Perplexity rerun; block reducer requires verified RAG generically.
owner_requirements.gap: Runtime needs a Perplexity-qualified evidence/rag-pending contract rather than generic verified status.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Required Perplexity success is provenance-qualified; bounded failure persists rag-pending and prevents terminal verdict/phase close.

owner_requirements.requirement: Retire only Task execution Layout v1, not unrelated v1-named contracts.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan_layout and commands still branch on Layout v1/v2; plan_migrate owns conversion.
owner_requirements.gap: Execution-specific v1 readers and command branches remain live.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Only execution-layout v1 paths are removed after migration; unrelated v1 schemas remain byte-compatible.

owner_requirements.requirement: Migrate all active repository and registered-project v1 plans before deleting readers; archives remain inert history.
owner_requirements.current_seam: plan_migrate exists and current readers still support v1.
owner_requirements.gap: No zero-active-v1 fleet proof exists yet, so reader and migrator removal is not admissible.
owner_requirements.acceptance: Inventory is complete, every active v1 plan is migrated and regenerated, zero-active-v1 is proven, then readers/commands/migrator retire while archives remain unchanged.
